New 2026 Nexus Maximus 34MX Diesel Super C RV for Sale at Motor Home Specialist; the #1 Volume Selling Motor Home Dealership in the World. **Price Includes All Manufacturer and Dealer Rebates** Optional Features Maximus Value Package Fiberglass Roof Composite Substrate in walls and roof IPO wood High Strength Low Alloy Steel Frame Throughout 20,000lb. Hitch HVAC Metal Ducting RVIA Certification Additional 100 Watt Solar Panel Nexair Fan in Living Room Theater Seats IPO Jackknife Sofa Oven Stackable Washer/Dryer Outside Kitchen Diamond Shield Roof Ladder  The Nexus RV boast an all STEEL cage construction that is 72% stronger than aluminum. You will also find construction highlights such as 2 layers of Azdel substrate in the sidewalls & roof! The Azdel product provides 3X the insulation value of wood and is 50% lighter which will help optimize your engine’s performance and fuel economy, and because it is not a wood material harvested from the rain forest it is both greener and provides a less that 1% chance of retaining any moisture that could ever lead to wall separation or mold. It is also formaldehyde free, impact resistant and a sound absorbing material creating a much quieter RV. To further protect and insulate the RV from the elements Nexus utilizes high grade UV protected automotive window seals. The roof is a pre-stamped metal roof truss system that is further highlighted by the exterior layer of seamless fiberglass as opposed to the normal TPO or 'rubber roofs' found in most RVs built today. The steel roof is also designed to incorporate Nexus RV's Easy-Flow Air Distribution system. This HVAC ducting is a tried-and-true system that provides more evenly distributed A/C throughout the coach as well as helps promote cleaner air and reduce allergens. Just a few additional features include seamless gelcoat sidewalls, steel framed floor, slide-out toppers, fully automatic leveling jacks, a diesel generator, deluxe full body paint, electric patio awning with LED light, 2 roof A/C units, heated and enclosed holding tanks, refrigerator, inverter, water filtration system, hardwood cabinetry, LED lighting, solid surface kitchen counters, deluxe booth dinette with storage, large flat screen TVs and more.
